themes.name: AI compute: NVIDIA's supply chain
themes.what: The chip remote access rule is now law: Commerce's rule was published in the Federal Register on Nov 19 (91 FR 74970) and took effect that day. Data centers already serving China linked firms at scale have 90 days, to about Feb 17, 2027, to get a license. TSMC and Samsung reportedly paused some chip deliveries to Chinese customers, smartphone chips included, while they apply for licenses (Financial Times via Yahoo Finance). Taiwan's Taiex fell 4.4% on Nov 19 (Investing.com). Nvidia then fell 3.30% to 145.98 and AMD 7.72% to 489.19 as the S&P 500 dropped 2.0% (Alpha Vantage closes; Yahoo Finance).
themes.for_you: The policy risk is no longer a date to wait for. AMD closed 489.19, under its long term stop 498.50, so it leaves the long term scan buy list case until it rebuilds a base. ENTG closed 138.14, just under its 139.69 point. No puts on chip names this week.

themes.name: Critical materials and geopolitics
themes.what: The Trump and Xi meeting in Shenzhen on Nov 19 ended with little change on chips, rare earths or tariffs (Yahoo Finance live, 8:27am ET). China's pause on its gallium, germanium and antimony ban to the US still ends Nov 27. Insiders kept buying US supply: MP's CFO bought about $92,000 at 34.86 on Nov 17, and a USA Rare Earth director bought about $3.0 million at 6.66 on Nov 17 (SEC Form 4s via the dashboard, filed Nov 18).
themes.for_you: No deal means the Nov 27 deadline is the next date that matters. MP rose 3.13% to 35.95 Wednesday (Massive) but is still in a downtrend with no buy point; watch for a base. No action.

themes.name: GLP-1 and obesity
themes.what: The CMS 'CRUSH' proposal (CMS-6098-P) was published in the Federal Register on Nov 19 as document 2026-23461; comments close Jan 19, 2027. Insurers fell again even though the text did not change: UNH -10.21% to 349.91 on 17.4 million shares and HUM -12.98% to 385.78 on Nov 18 (Massive), then UNH -5.55% to 330.48 and CI -4.32% to 273.04 on Nov 19 (Alpha Vantage). Oppenheimer expects legal challenges and says plans would likely price the cost into bids (Yahoo Finance).
themes.for_you: CI broke its range on volume Wednesday (285.37 on 1.54x) and kept falling, now 5.3% under its 288.40 long term point, so that point no longer holds. No puts on any insurer while the comment period runs.
